title: Covered Item Eligibility and Purchase Limits for Northgate Protect Plans
content:
A Northgate Protect plan covers an item only when the item's category is one the tier can cover and its net price paid before tax lies between the tier's lowest and highest coverable item price. The same facet fixes whether Northgate Marketplace items can be covered, how long after the item purchase a single-item plan can still be bought, which earlier purchases Northgate Protect Complete Monthly reaches back to, and how many plans can cover one item at a time.

## Item price range and categories

| Tier | Lowest net item price | Highest net item price | Item categories the tier can cover |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard 2-Year | $20.00 | $5000.00 | TV and home theater; computers and tablets; major appliances; small appliances; video games; smart home; fitness equipment; furniture |
| Standard 3-Year | $20.00 | $5000.00 | TV and home theater; computers and tablets; major appliances; small appliances; video games; smart home; fitness equipment; furniture |
| Accident 2-Year | $50.00 | $5000.00 | TV and home theater; computers and tablets; mobile phones; video games; smart home; small appliances |
| Accident 3-Year | $50.00 | $5000.00 | TV and home theater; computers and tablets; mobile phones; video games; smart home; small appliances |
| Accident 4-Year | $50.00 | $5000.00 | TV and home theater; computers and tablets; mobile phones; video games; smart home; small appliances |
| Complete Monthly | $20.00 | $2500.00 | TV and home theater; computers and tablets; mobile phones; major appliances; small appliances; video games; smart home; fitness equipment |

## Purchase timing, marketplace items and plans per item

| Tier | Marketplace items coverable | Days after the item purchase date to buy a single-item plan | Days before enrollment within which earlier Northgate purchases are covered | Most plans covering one item at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard 2-Year | No | 30 | Not applicable | 1 |
| Standard 3-Year | No | 30 | Not applicable | 1 |
| Accident 2-Year | No | 30 | Not applicable | 1 |
| Accident 3-Year | No | 30 | Not applicable | 1 |
| Accident 4-Year | No | 30 | Not applicable | 1 |
| Complete Monthly | No | 30 | 60 | 1 |

Northgate Marketplace items, Fulfilled by Northgate items included, could be covered only on a tier where marketplace coverage is marked yes; no tier marks it yes. The purchase window is counted in calendar days after the covered item's purchase date. The look-back of 60 calendar days before enrollment applies to Northgate Protect Complete Monthly only.

## Points of judgement

- *Hypothetical:* a mobile phone bought for a net $40.00 is below the $50.00 lowest price of every Accident tier and is not a category the Standard tiers cover, so no single-item tier can cover it; on price and category it falls within Complete Monthly, whose lowest price is $20.00 and whose categories include mobile phones.
- A furniture item can be covered by the Standard tiers only; furniture is not in the Accident or Complete Monthly category lists.
- An item priced at exactly the lowest or highest figure of a tier is within that tier's range.
